ThreadCountTooltip: More threads can speed up rate-limited downloads, but too many threads may cause severe lag during downloads. Generally, 64 threads are sufficient for most download needs.
SpeedLimitTooltip: Set a maximum download speed to avoid causing other network-dependent programs to freeze
FolderLocationNote: Please change the download target folder in Launch → Instance Selection → Folder List. Right-click on any folder or game instance to open the corresponding folder.
UpgradeAuthlibTooltip: Some MC versions (like 1.16.5) have bugs that may disable multiplayer when using offline authentication. PCL can try to upgrade the Authlib support library for these versions to solve the problem. This setting only applies to newly installed instances.
FilenameFormatTooltip: Default filename format when downloading community resources
ModManagementStyleTooltip: Display style of mod items in the mod management page
IgnoreQuiltTooltip: Ignore Quilt when displaying mod loaders
AutoDetectClipboardTooltip: When enabled, PCL will read your clipboard and recognize resource links, asking if you want to jump to the details page.
ReleaseUpdateTooltip: Show popup notification when Minecraft release updates
SnapshotUpdateTooltip: Show popup notification when Minecraft test versions (snapshots, pre-releases) update
ShowImportantOnly: Show announcements only for important notifications
ShowAllAnnouncementsTooltip: Show all announcements including launcher feature surveys, activities, etc.
AnimationFramerateTooltip: If you disable hardware acceleration, it is recommended to lower the maximum animation framerate to prevent excessive resource usage
RealtimeLogLinesTooltip: Maximum number of lines displayed in the real-time log function. Old logs will be automatically deleted when this limit is exceeded.
DisableHardwareAccelerationTooltip: Disabling hardware acceleration can improve compatibility on some systems but may reduce performance
ParticipateInSurveyTooltip: This is a plan similar to Steam's hardware survey. Participating in the survey helps us better plan and develop, and we will periodically publish the statistical results of this survey. If you choose to participate, we will collect the following information: launcher version information and ID, Windows system version and architecture used, installed physical memory size, NAT and IPv6 support status, whether you have used the official version of PCL, HMCL or BakaXL. This data is not associated with you, and we will never sell data to third parties. Not participating in the survey will not affect your use of other features.
UseDohResolutionTooltip: Using DoH for DNS resolution can get better quality IP results and improve the launcher's network access level. If you have deployed a DoH resolution service, you can disable this feature.
UntrustedProxyWarning: Do not enter untrusted proxy addresses
ProxyAddressTooltip: Incorrect proxy server addresses will cause network connection failures. Network issues caused by using proxies will not be addressed. Do not enter untrusted proxy server addresses, as this may lead to your account information being leaked or even stolen.
DebugModeTooltip: Show debug information and more error information. This will slightly decrease launcher performance. It is not recommended to enable unless you have special needs.
AddDelayTooltip: Add random delays in various stages to slow down loading and test whether some functions work normally. This will seriously affect launcher operation. It is not recommended to enable unless you have special needs.
ProhibitCopyingFilesTooltip: Do not directly copy identical files that already exist in other MC folders during download, but re-download files instead. Only recommended when testing download speeds.
AnnouncementWarning: If you choose this option, you will not be able to get relevant notifications even if serious problems occur in the future. For example, if a certain version of the game is found to have a serious bug, you may not be able to predict the consequences because you cannot get notifications. Generally, choosing 'Show announcements only for important notifications' will minimize disturbances. Unless you are making server modpacks or frequently manually update the launcher, it is strongly not recommended to choose this option!
